actions.name: Exploit CVE-2023-2868 vulnerability in Barracuda ESG appliances
actions.description: Suspected PRC cyber actors exploited a remote command injection vulnerability (CVE-2023-2868) in Barracuda ESG appliances by sending specially formatted TAR file attachments to email addresses affiliated with domains connected to ESG appliances, triggering command injection during email attachment scanning.
actions.epistemic_reason: 原文以不確定語氣陳述（如 may have／appears to／we believe），不是已確認的事實。

actions.name: Establish reverse shell on compromised ESG appliance
actions.description: Malicious email attachments initiated a connection to a domain or IP address controlled by the cyber actors and established a reverse shell, allowing execution of further commands on the ESG device.

actions.name: Drop malicious payloads on compromised ESG appliances
actions.description: After compromising the ESG device, the cyber actors dropped various malicious payloads onto the vulnerable machines to enable persistent access, email scanning, credential harvesting, and data exfiltration.
actions.epistemic_reason: 原文以不確定語氣陳述（如 may have／appears to／we believe），不是已確認的事實。

actions.name: Use ESG appliance as entry point for lateral movement and further email attacks
actions.description: In some cases, the actors used initial access to the ESG appliance as an entry point to the rest of the victim’s network or sent emails to other victim appliances.

actions.name: Obfuscate actions with counter-forensic techniques
actions.description: The cyber actors obfuscated their actions with counter-forensic techniques, making detection of compromise difficult through only scanning the appliance itself for indicators of compromise.
